changes.reason: disable the runtime's own setup thread. It exists to install detours on ExecuteCommandLists, the two CreateSwapChain overloads and the two Presents, so that the DLL can drive itself. This add-on drives it instead, and the two cannot both hold the wheel
the detour above calls the original ExecuteCommandLists before notifying. The add-on calls that notify entry itself, after its own submit, so the call here would execute the list a second time
report the timeout fallback accurately: with ToneChannels bit 4 set and bit 2 clear the shader shows nothing, not the previous residual

the runtime's atexit destructor (RVA 0x52ec) calls std::terminate, which is abort(), while the inline watchdog std::thread at 0x97970 is still joinable, because its DllMain detaches only the worker. At process exit the kernel has already ended that thread, so leave the handle to the exit instead of aborting

dropped.reason: the shader edit that made a timed-out frame keep its own input instead of pasting last frame's residual. v0.2.17 offers the same choice as ToneChannels bit 4 with bit 2 clear, which the add-on now sets, so there is nothing left to patch

never applied here and still is not. It bounds the wait shader at 262144 iterations, about 6 ms, against a network that takes 9 to 187 ms, so inline mode would time out on every frame and the apply pass would keep its input
